changelog:
Initial release of the action-runner skill.

- Safely executes recommendations as real actions (e.g., opening tickets, posting updates) via GitHub, Linear, Slack, etc.
- Previews all actions in a dry-run plan, classifies per-action risk (🟢/🟡/🔴), and requires approval before any execution.
- Explicitly gates, confirms, and logs outbound or destructive (🔴) actions per item.
- Limits execution strictly to user-specified repos/channels/projects, using only connected MCPs.
- Records all executed actions to the brain for provenance and auditability; never acts silently.
summary: Turn a skill's recommendations into real, executed actions — open the tickets, file the issues, post the updates — safely: dry-run preview, risk-classified,...
